external_collaboration.partner_name: AIAP, Associazione italiana di design della comunicazione visiva
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: ● The IDD is a member of the AIAP, Associazione italiana di design della comunicazione visiva, i.e. the Italian Association of Visual Communication Design.

● The IDD is a member of the ADI, Associazione del Design Industriale, i.e. Industrial Design Association, with which it has close and continuous relations, in particular with the ADI regional territorial delegation of Puglia and Basilicata.
The IDD cooperates with the Sassi Foundation, carrying out projects for an increasing enhancement of the local artistic and historical heritage.
